source_summary: Ink-and-light-color Chinese landscape with snowy/misty hills, clustered village roofs, bare winter trees, pines, rocky ravines, and a pale winding stream; inscription and red seals are excluded.

motifs.name: upper_ridge_hamlet
motifs.description: Isolate the distant upper-center ridge with several small roofed structures, sparse dark trees, and pale snow/mist bands along the hill crest.
must_preserve: tiny layered roof geometry with dark ink eaves
scattered upright tree trunks and dot foliage
soft grey dry-brush ridge texture
pale ochre wash accents on slopes
irregular white mist/snow edges separating the ridge from the background

motifs.name: mid_mountain_gateway
motifs.description: Isolate the small central mountain building or gateway set into rocks, with a narrow path and enclosing dark washes.
must_preserve: dark angular roofline and central ridge cap
vertical support lines and arched opening
narrow pale path descending from the structure
surrounding crag strokes in grey ink
subtle peach-ochre wall and rock accents

motifs.name: left_foreground_village_compound
motifs.description: Isolate the large foreground-left cluster of connected houses and courtyards with snow-covered roofs and peach-toned walls.
must_preserve: long black roof outlines and white roof planes
small tower-like roof at the center-left of the compound
vertical wall posts in warm peach wash
courtyard wall geometry and overlapping building volumes
dry-brush ink edges showing snow on roofs

motifs.name: winter_orchard_thicket
motifs.description: Isolate the foreground thicket of leafless winter trees and shrubs in front of the village, including branching trunks and low rocky ground.
must_preserve: expressive bare branch linework
dark clustered trunk bases
grey and ochre rock washes beneath the trees
fine twig networks crossing the lower foreground
small black foliage dots and dry-brush texture

motifs.name: right_mid_slope_pine_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the middle-right snowy hillside with a dense row of small pines and dark dotted shrubs along terraced slopes.
must_preserve: closely spaced black pine dots and vertical trunks
curving snow-covered terrace edges
grey dry-brush rock texture
soft ochre wash on exposed earth
misty white negative spaces between slope bands

motifs.name: lower_right_roof_cluster
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right village buildings tucked below the pine slope, with overlapping sloped roofs, pale walls, and a descending path edge.
must_preserve: overlapping white roof planes outlined in ink
peach and tan wall washes
short vertical window or post strokes
diagonal path or wall lines linking the buildings
dark shrub dots around the structures

motifs.name: central_rocky_ravine_bridge
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-center rocky ravine area with pale stream channel, small plank bridge or fence, and clustered stones.
must_preserve: thin vertical fence or bridge slats
pale winding water channel left as negative space
rounded rock forms with grey contour strokes
ochre dry-brush accents on stones
dark ink dots marking vegetation along the ravine edge

motifs.name: right_foreground_cliffs_and_figure
motifs.description: Isolate the right foreground cliff mass beside the pale stream, including the craggy rocks and the small dark robed figure near the lower path.
must_preserve: large angular cliff outlines in grey ink
soft ochre washes on rock faces
white stream or path cutting vertically through the rocks
small dark human figure silhouette near the lower edge
black vegetation dots and dry-brush rock texture

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
